name: v0.3.36 one distractor link after hub branches
research_question: After a hub's branch clicks are started, does one untried distractor link confirm the navigation-loop bug without losing Guard bugs?
diagnosis: On quarry budget 120 the candidate confirmed the blank page, the boundary search bug, the empty-title bug, and the probe and export bugs. It never opened help.html. The help link text is a distractor, so it is not a branch click and the hub explorer does not start it. The loop behind that link stayed unconfirmed. Guard also missed it. The v0.3.35 module is not edited.
not: an edit of the frozen v0.3.35 candidate
permission to take a distractor before untried branch clicks
permission to take a return link
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the fresh matrix

candidate.rule: On a hub that is not returning, after every branch click has been started, take one untried distractor link. Do not take a return. Each hub cluster gets one such click.

topology_rule: New positives keep the chart-to-prefs page and the help-settings loop behind the home help link.

outcomes.C: Guard loss on a fresh target, historical Guard loss, safety violation, negative handoff, candidate edit, or product-default change
outcomes.D: Safety holds but fewer than 3 positives are evaluable
outcomes.B: Guard bugs are kept and at least 3 positives are evaluable, but fewer than 3 keep every Guard bug, confirm the navigation-loop bug, and record a hub-distractor selection
outcomes.A: At least 3 positives keep every Guard bug, confirm the navigation-loop bug, and record a hub-distractor selection. Negatives have no nested handoff. The historical suite loses no Guard bug. The product default stays unchanged.
